# Shandong Shengyuan Peptide Technology Co., Ltd.

> Research-grade custom peptide synthesis, OEM private label manufacturing, and batch-verified quality — from Shandong, China, to research institutions in 50+ countries. All products are laboratory research materials only.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://shengyuanpeptides.com/): Company overview, core services, featured products.
- [Product Catalog](https://shengyuanpeptides.com/products/): 24 research peptides with batch-specific COA data.
- [Custom Peptide Synthesis](https://shengyuanpeptides.com/custom-peptide-synthesis/): Workflow, scales, modifications, turnaround.
- [OEM & Private Label](https://shengyuanpeptides.com/oem/): Formulation, private label packaging, dossiers, global logistics.
- [COA Lookup](https://shengyuanpeptides.com/coa/): Verify any batch by verification code or batch number.
- [Quality Control](https://shengyuanpeptides.com/quality/): Release panel — HPLC, MS, peptide content, water content, endotoxin.
- [About](https://shengyuanpeptides.com/about/): Company story and team.
- [FAQ](https://shengyuanpeptides.com/faq/)
- [Contact](https://shengyuanpeptides.com/contact/): aaron@shengyuanpeptides.com, WhatsApp +64 2102668969.
